t0303-01.gloss: A personal trace links trial residue to illness before a later restriction.
t0303-01.rival_reading: A response team could have carried farm supplies while checking exposure; the objects and timing do not establish that the trial caused it.

t0303-02.gloss: A receiver was maintained during a siege but could not be used to answer.
t0303-02.rival_reading: The same frequency might have carried warnings about a field treatment, not instructions to control the people inside.
